settings.editor: Answers on ordering, drawings, lead times, materials and capability. If your question is not here, our engineers will answer it directly.

tabs.tab_title: If I cannot see it, how do I know you did it?
tabs.tab_content: We verify all of our work with high-magnification inspection systems, and use machine vision and frame grabbing technologies when necessary. We supply Certificates of Conformance on request.
Yes. We will work with you to expedite orders. On some occasions a modest fee may apply to accommodate a rush order.

tabs.tab_title: Do you accept orders for single parts and prototypes?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We gladly accept prototyping projects and aim to build a relationship that sees your product through to production.

tabs.tab_title: In what format should drawings be submitted?
tabs.tab_content: For laser and micro-CNC projects we prefer .dxf files, with units in millimetres and the drawing centred. 3D printing projects require an .stl file; please state the unit of measure to apply.

tabs.tab_title: What is the typical lead time for a project?
tabs.tab_content: Depending on the application, some projects can be completed within 24 to 48 hours of receiving the order. More complex or higher-volume projects can take up to 2 to 3 weeks.

tabs.tab_title: What is required to get a proposal?
tabs.tab_content: Typically, a description of your project and/or a drawing.

tabs.tab_title: What is the smallest feature size that can be machined?
tabs.tab_content: About 1 micron. Feature size can be limited by the type and thickness of the material, and our staff can help you understand the limits for your material.
Almost any material, including polymers, metals, glass and ceramics. Our relationship with Goodfellow has increased our access to new materials.

tabs.tab_title: What micro-manufacturing technologies does Goodfellow Microfabrication offer?
tabs.tab_content: A broad range, including laser machining, micro-CNC and 3D printing.

settings.editor: Send a drawing or a short description of your project. Our engineers review every design and respond within one business day.
